originalLicenseNote: Engine source under MIT; embeds Viridithas network v109 (sandhi-s2-b200.nnue.zst) from https://github.com/cosmobobak/viridithas-networks (MIT).
blurb: Viridithas 20.0.0 is an MIT-licensed Rust UCI chess engine by Cosmo Bobak, developed since 2022 with original self-play training data and networks trained using bullet. It pairs magic bitboards, heavily tuned fractional LMR, singular/double/triple extensions, and multi-source correction histories with an embedded multi-layer NNUE featuring horizontally mirrored king buckets, threat and pawn-tuple inputs, and 8 material output buckets. Adapted to UCI over WASI on the poll helper with WebAssembly 128-bit SIMD.
fidelityNotes: Single-threaded plain wasm32-wasip1 build with 128-bit WebAssembly SIMD (+simd128) matching AVX2/NEON float FMA and reduction order; embedded zstd-compressed NNUE decompressed in memory; no Syzygy tablebases; Hash capped at 1024 MB.

features.label: Magic Bitboards
features.implementation: 64-bit magic bitboards with portable ray geometry under WASI.

features.label: PVS
features.implementation: Type-parameterized Root/PV/non-PV negamax search with iterative deepening and aspiration windows.

features.label: Null Move Pruning
features.implementation: Improving-aware dynamic null-move pruning scaled by depth and static eval margin.

features.label: Fractional LMR
features.implementation: Fixed-point LMR adjusted by PV, TT-PV, cut-node, check, correction, and move history terms.

features.label: Singular Extensions
features.implementation: Singular, double, and triple extensions paired with hindsight depth adjustments.

features.label: ProbCut
features.implementation: Adaptive SEE-scaled ProbCut pruning on high-value captures.

features.label: Reverse Futility & Razoring
features.implementation: Improving-adjusted reverse futility pruning alongside futility pruning, razoring, and SEE pruning.

features.label: Continuation & Correction History
features.implementation: Main, pawn, and 1-/2-/4-ply continuation histories plus pawn, minor, major, non-pawn, and continuation correction histories.

features.label: Tactical History
features.implementation: Capture and promotion history combined with SEE for tactical move ordering and pruning.

features.label: Transposition Table
features.implementation: Hash table storing bounds, PV flags, best moves, and static evaluations.

features.label: Multi-Layer NNUE
features.implementation: Embedded bullet-trained 1024x2 -> 32 -> 32 -> 1 NNUE with 16 horizontally mirrored king buckets, threat and pawn-tuple features, and 8 material output buckets.
